visual_action: A montage of clips showing Donald Trump dancing and gesturing at various events, including large rallies and on a stage in front of American flags. He is wearing suits and at times a 'MAKE AMERICA GREAT AGAIN' hat.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the subject of every clip in the montage and is criticized by the on-screen text.

on_screen_text.text: convinced gng I'd lower prices on day one but crashed the economy instead

spoken_summary: There is no spoken dialogue. The audio consists of lyrics from the hip-hop song 'Lifestyle' by Rich Gang, which includes the lines 'I done did a lot of shit just to live this here lifestyle' and 'from the bottom to the top of my lifestyle'.
audio_music: The hip-hop song 'Lifestyle' by Rich Gang plays throughout the video. The upbeat track creates a mocking or ironic tone when paired with the critical on-screen text about economic failure.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with quick cuts between various clips of Donald Trump.
cultural_references: The song 'Lifestyle' by the hip-hop group Rich Gang.
The use of the slang term 'gng' (gang) in the on-screen text.
central_claim: Donald Trump failed on his promise to lower prices and instead damaged the economy.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump as economically incompetent and untrustworthy, thereby discouraging support for him.
uncertainty_flags: The text on a white hat worn by Donald Trump in one clip is not fully legible.
